reviews.title: Flawed and broken
reviews.text: Could be very good but the daily routines don’t reset daily (tasks I ticked off the day before are ticked off today) and it’s filled with jargon I have to look up. Why not have a section that explains the method and all the jargon? I don’t want to have to look up a video each time I come across a new term.

reviews.title: Error message
reviews.text: App does not work. Error message when signing up. No way to contact support for help.

reviews.title: Maybe it’s me
reviews.text: So I get that the goal is to buy the program. I bought the book year’s ago. But what am I paying $1.99 a week for if it’s not full access? What does the weekly fee get me? If I pay the $99 does that give me access to everything?

reviews.title: Upset with my subscription
reviews.text:
I wouldn’t suggest this app to anyone. Sure it’s cool that you can set up routines, but it doesn’t allow you to set up alerts/notifications when it’s time to do your routine. That’s what I need otherwise I forget to even open the app.

I reached out for help, but the support team is completely unresponsive.

I’m definitely cancelling my subscription and will look for something better.

reviews.title: Not worth the cost
reviews.text: I’ve been following with the free app for about a month and have been relatively pleased so upgraded to FlyladyPlus. Sadly, either there’s something wrong with the upgrade or it’s a rip off because there’s not hardly any change from the free version and in some ways is even less user-friendly.

reviews.title: App Stuck on July 31
reviews.text: The app has been stuck on July 31.  Where is the app manager to address this issue? Not worth downloading if it is not working.

reviews.title: Doesn't Work
reviews.text: Nothing functions in the app unless you sign up for a subscription. It also requires you to have a login, but every time I tried to create an account, the app displayed an error.

reviews.title: Zones switch every few days
reviews.text: I’ve had the app for less than a week and have had my zones switch twice now. Today I got a notification that I was in my third zone. Aren’t the zones supposed to be for one week at a time?

reviews.title: Not Free…requires account login
reviews.text: The description specifically states at the bottom “no login required”. This is a lie. Nowhere in the description does it say you have to pay $1.99 a week or $37 a year to use this app.  Absolutely nothing in this app is free, and nowhere does it state anything about payments payments or in app purchases

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: Used to be super awesome and helpful, used this app for years when it was free and now the whole thing just seems like a soulless cash grab. Used to be able to tailor the whole app to your house for FREE now you have to pay to do just about anything. Also why can’t we access zones were not currently in anymore?? I move a lot and I can’t even adjust my zones to match where I’m at anymore. Thinking of deleting soon if I can’t figure something out. Your best bet is to find a free version or make your own “zones” in your phones notes app 😒 just so disappointed now

reviews.title: Uuhhg
reviews.text: Too bad the website isn’t as good and as easy to use as it once was, because unfortunately, the app is horrible!

reviews.title: No  monthly plan
reviews.text: Was looking forward to this could not afford the £40 so went for the £3.99 a month, but after logging in if you do not want the yearly the only other option is £1.99 a week 😱 that's £102.38 now that's a rip off, shame on you.

reviews.title: Paid for premium and can’t access
reviews.text: In February I paid for premium access and was billed. Still can’t access the premium interface and the developer is no where to be found!

reviews.title: UPDATE - Courses don’t load
reviews.text:
The courses were supposed to be INCLUDED in my premium subscription and now that I waited to see if bugs were fixed - they now want $100 to access what was said to be included when I purchased the premium subscription! WTH??? I even emailed app support and heard nothing back. This is scandalous. If you want to charge more for your videos that’s one thing - but what happened here is actually illegal and if it’s not amended I will report to the BBB. 

I was excited to see I could access courses through the app and pick up where I’d left off waaayyy back in 2006. Unfortunately the app developer has not got back to my support question on why the courses don’t load with the Plus plan. Next stop: I will be seeking a refund. Wish the book was in publication because I wanted to buy that first. Otherwise I haven’t found clear direction on methods again and I know they are fabulous. Very sad about being unable to deepen my knowledge. I still shine my sink and use other tips I learned so long ago from her blog.

reviews.title: Not for me
reviews.text: I’ve been on and off the flylady system for over 20 years.  It always helped me get back on track.  I have been feeling over cluttered and tried the website and this app.  It’s not for me.  Wish we could still use the old website.  It wasn’t flashy but it was from the heart.  I think I may still have an old control journal somewhere I will turn to that instead.  The old website had everything right there.  The new website doesn’t have much and the app just didn’t seem useful to me.  Would love to go back to old way.  Thank you for all the help over the years, maybe this new way will bring more to the great system.

reviews.title: Beware! Horrible support
reviews.text:
I have used this app happily for two years at least. I decided recently to upgrade and unlock the features. I paid for it but nothing changed. 

I understand things happen so I contacted flylady to correct this. I  have been trying for almost two months now. 

I have contacted them through the app, through her Facebook group, online in every way imaginable. No response!! Nothing? Really?

What a rip off. 

It was a good amount of work to get all the zones set up for me so I didn’t want to give up on it. I will switch apps now.

reviews.title: Unable to log in
reviews.text: I keep getting an error when I try to login with my email~it tells me to log in with apple.  When I do that it tells me I already have an account.  I’m not signing up, just trying to log in.

reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text: I’ve had the app a long time and it used to be all free. But now you have to have ANOTHER subscription to use all the zones of cleaning.  If you want it for just regular daily habits it’s fine. But it’s a pity that you are forced to pay to use the whole app now :(

reviews.title: Some things need to be left alone
reviews.text: I am incredibly disappointed in the revamped app and consider the money spent a waste. I hate that! I used and loved her system for years but neither the website nor this new app are an improvement or easy to use

reviews.title: Free better than paid
reviews.text: I’m so annoyed I paid for a year, the paid version is worse than the free! Fewer rooms, and editing is exhausting with how many steps it takes. It’s clear insufficient testing occurred before release. This has so much potential, but execution was poor.

reviews.title: App doesn’t work
reviews.text: Love fly lady and have used the system off and on for years.  But the app doesn’t work.  I get an error message when I try to login.   I have tried everything…..deleting and reinstalling.   Tried to reset password, nothing works.  Very disappointing.

reviews.title: It was great before the last update
reviews.text: I was really enjoying this app. The ability to customize cleaning like I wanted was great. Then the latest update happened and I can’t customize zones anymore unless you pay. We are moving soon and now I won’t even be able to update rooms to the new house. Disappointing. Off to look for a new app

reviews.title: Update Ruined It
reviews.text: I’m so disappointed. I have been using this app for years. The latest update over wrote all of my custom lists, I can’t edit the lists, and I can no longer access any zone I want (only the current zone). I miss the fireworks animation when a list was finished. I liked it better when a finished task went to the bottom of the list and now completed lists aren’t easily visible I have to read for 5/5 or however many tasks are finished. Feels like a money grab to me. There are better cleaning apps if I’m going to pay a subscription. They totally ruined it for me

reviews.title: Ruined app since update
reviews.text: Well since getting away from my routine after having my second baby, I redownloaded the app to restart my routine. I guess since I last used this months ago, they revamped the entire app. The features are no longer free. I cannot edit my zones. They are making me pay $1.99 a week for what? Honestly this app was perfect before and now it’s trash. Cancelled, would literally rather use my notes app.

reviews.title: Bugs that don’t get fixed
reviews.text: Been tryna use this app for months. Theres a bug that won’t let me create an account or sign in. Been trying to get them to fix it but the website is under construction so I can contact anyone!

reviews.title: Take your money and run
reviews.text: I paid for an annual membership only to find out that this app does not work properly.  I emailed the developer back then, asking for my money back.  No response.  I notice now they say they are under construction.  I have already cancelled this subscription and won’t be renewing because they basically stole my money and did not make things right.

reviews.title: App is not working
reviews.text: Zero updates. Missions stuck on Tuesday. Has flylady completely shut down?

reviews.title: App Doesn’t Work
reviews.text:
Edited to add that months after my initial review it’s STILL not working. 

 For months now the app has been glitched. At least 6 months.  The mission of the day has been stuck on zone 4 the entire 6 months.  The posts are repeated over and over most from years ago and aren’t relevant. For example - musings about getting ready for Christmas were posted in May.  It’s not supported at all as people have been complaining for months. Please don’t pay for the premium - it’s a total scam.

reviews.title: What?
reviews.text: I paid for something that doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Needs updates
reviews.text: The daily mission and weekly zones have not changed at all in since I downloaded the app 2 weeks ago. I’m very disappointed.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: This is a great model for cleaning.  Unfortunately, the app seems poorly monitored. It’s been stuck on the same day for awhile.  Many have commented in the app but there’s been no change.  Hoping to get a refund.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work, don’t waste your money
reviews.text: I’ve followed FlyLady on and off over the years. I was so excited to see she finally had an app with a reasonable subscription. You obviously get what you pay for because the app is broken. Doesn’t update daily missions. Why am I paying for something that I have to go dig around her new website for?!  I really expected better.

reviews.title: Missions are so problematic
reviews.text: Missions are inconsistent on the app and now the website as well. I’m so irritated with having to pick up my distracting phone to check on something that should help me be productive and I’m just distracted instead. I’ve finally started a list for my own missions. I’m so glad I didn’t pay for this yet.

reviews.title: Total disappointment
reviews.text: Love the FlyLady system, but the app doesn’t work and has been a complete waste of money. No updates - the courses are not available at all. Don’t bother with this one.

reviews.title: Broken
reviews.text: Don’t waste your money. This app could be wonderful, but it isn’t working; for instance, the missions have been stuck in one zone for months. I canceled my subscription; I will happily resubscribe if it’s ever fixed, but for now it’s useless.

reviews.title: SCAM ALERT!! DO NOT PAY FOR THE PREMIUM VERSION OF APP!
reviews.text:
The premium version is stuck on a certain week of cleaning…for now over 6 months.
ZERO CUSTOMER SERVICE!  No response from help desk, no response for asking for money back. They just collect money for app and post things for sale on the FB page. Thinking all these great recent reviews are paid for?  Use TOM app instead!  Legit app and business.

reviews.title: Needs an update
reviews.text: App isn’t letting me save changes to zones. Likely needs an update.

reviews.title: App Broken
reviews.text: Key features of the app do not work and have not worked for over 6 months. It could be great again but no one responds to it being broken.

reviews.title: Needs updates
reviews.text: I love the Fly Lady and her approach to cleaning and organization.  But the app needs to be updated! It is giving confusing missions saying we are in one particular zone and then other places saying we are in a different zone.
